variants.prompt: The Mediterranean goddess struts confidently along the teak deck of a sleek, modern yacht, the warm breeze tousling her auburn locks. Her porcelain skin glows with a sun-kissed sheen beneath a barely-there bikini, the iridescent fabric clinging to her voluptuous figure like a second skin. A gold chain belt cinches at her hips, drawing attention to her slender waist and the tantalizing curves below. She sashays toward the camera, her emerald eyes flashing with a seductive, come-hither gaze.
